subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II access — NDA countersign + bridge letter clarification
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@fincraft.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@fincraft.com, security@fincraft.com
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II access request — NDA gating

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the earlier demo — FinCraft's procurement and security teams are moving toward a final evaluation. As part of our vendor onboarding we need access to your SOC 2 Type II report and a short bridge letter that confirms the audit period.

We can only receive the report under an executed NDA. I've attached our standard SOC access request form with the dates we'd like covered. Can your team: 1) confirm whether you can provide the Type II report under NDA, 2) countersign our NDA (I attached a draft for you to review), and 3) confirm the audit window covered by the report?

Target: we'd like to complete legal review by Friday, 2028-07-06 so procurement can finish the POC signoff.

Files attached: Fincraft_SOC_Access_Form.pdf (application/pdf), Fincraft_NDA_v1_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate it — feel free to loop in legal.

Best,
Liam O'Neal
Security Program Manager, FinCraft
liam.oneal@fincraft.com
+1 (415) 555-2210

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@fincraft.com>, procurement@fincraft.com, security@fincraft.com
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II access request — NDA gating

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding a request from FinCraft. They need our Type II report under NDA plus a short bridge letter stating the audit period. Procurement wants legal to countersign the attached NDA so they can receive the report.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: can you review the attached Fincraft_NDA_v1_draft.pdf and advise if we can countersign as-is or provide a redline? Key points: one-way disclosure, limited distribution to security/procurement, and a 12‑month retention limitation on their side.
- Marcus: once we have the NDA path, can you confirm whether the report we have on record covers the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 and whether a bridge letter is acceptable to them? If we need to redact any operational details for shared reporting, flag that too.

They've asked for a turnaround by Friday — I'll coordinate with procurement to get DocuSign executed if legal signs off. Attaching their request form for context.

Attachments: Fincraft_NDA_v1_draft.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_Bridge_Request_Form.pdf

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com
+1 (650) 555-0139

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@fincraft.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II access request — NDA gating

Hi Neha / Marcus — reviewed FinCraft's NDA. Summary / next steps:

1) Redlines: I attached a redlined PDF (Redlined_NDA_neha_marissa_v1.pdf). Main edits:
   - Limit recipients to named individuals (procurement/security aliases are ok)
   - Add explicit non-retention clause (60 days after report receipt) for the SOC artifact
   - Clarify permitted use: evaluation only, no distribution to third parties
   - Remove indemnity carve-outs that were unusually broad

2) Bridge letter: we can provide a short bridge letter confirming the audit period (2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31) and that there have been no material control changes up to 2028-06-30. I drafted a one-page Bridge_Letter_Draft_20280703.pdf; please review for technical accuracy. Marcus — confirm the control-change statement is acceptable from a product standpoint.

3) Execution: once Neha confirms we can proceed, I'll countersign and upload to DocuSign. We should request that FinCraft sign and return within 48 hours. Also recommend logging this as a gated delivery in the SOC Evidence Tracker (HubSpot deal HUB-91247).

Note: We'll only share the full Type II report after the executed NDA is in our DocuSign system. If FinCraft needs a redacted summary while legal finishes, we can consider that but would prefer the NDA route.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

--- Attachment: Redlined_NDA_neha_marissa_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
--- Attachment: Bridge_Letter_Draft_20280703.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request — NDA gating

Hi Liam — thanks for the request and for sharing the form. We're prepared to proceed on an NDA-gated basis. Summary below and next steps: 

- NDA: Our legal team has redlined your draft (attached) and will countersign once you confirm the changes. For expediency we'll upload our countersigned version to DocuSign and send you a signing request. Link will be provided in the next hour.
- Bridge letter: attached is the draft bridge letter confirming the SOC 2 Type II audit period of 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 and no material control changes through 2028-06-30. Please confirm that language is sufficient for procurement.
- Timeline: If FinCraft executes the NDA via DocuSign within 48 hours, we'll grant access to the Type II report within one business day of execution.

Attachments: Redlined_NDA_neha_marissa_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Bridge_Letter_Draft_20280703.pdf (application/pdf)
